} } } } /* If WriteAddr is not EEPROM_PAGESIZE aligned */ else { /* If nbr_of_bytes < EEPROM_PAGESIZE */ if(numofpages == 0U) { /* If the number of data to be written is more than the remaining space in the current page: */ if(nbr_of_bytes > count) { /* Write the data contained in same page */ if(EEPROM_WriteBytes(Instance, write_buffer, write_addr, count) != BSP_ERROR_NONE) { ret = BSP_ERROR_COMPONENT_FAILURE;
